text:
Which statement about the temperature of the solid describes what happens when a solid is
melting?
A
The temperature increases and there is an input of energy.
B
The temperature increases and there is no input of energy.
C
The temperature remains constant and there is an input of energy.
D
The temperature remains constant and there is no input of energy.

options.label: A
options.text: The temperature increases and there is an input of energy.

options.label: B
options.text: The temperature increases and there is no input of energy.

options.label: C
options.text: The temperature remains constant and there is an input of energy.

options.label: D
options.text: The temperature remains constant and there is no input of energy.
